name: SUNO | 200mg Tablets | CBG
description:
Established out of a desire to improve patient well-being, RISE products provide a robust custom cannabis platform. Each tablet contains 10mg total cannabinoids and natural terpenes. RISE products are also free of sugar, gluten, and nuts.

10mg CBG Tablets are non-psychoactive and promote endocannabinoid support and anti-nausea.

CBG Tablets - 10mg per tablet. 20 tablets/bottle

Custom ratios. Custom doses. Custom cannabis.
